# Clerodendrum speciosissimum Jacob-Makoy

First published in Nursery Cat. (L.Jacob-Makoy & Co.) 1836: 19 (1836)

This species is accepted

The native range of this species is W. Malesia, New Guinea to Vanuatu. It is a shrub and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome. It is has environmental uses and as a medicine.

## Distribution

  *   * KBD

### Native to:

Bismarck Archipelago, Borneo, Jawa, Malaya, New Guinea, Solomon Is., Sumatera, Vanuatu

### Introduced into:

Bahamas, Caroline Is., Congo, Cook Is., Cuba, Dominican Republic, El Salvador, Fiji, Florida, Gabon, Ghana, Guatemala, Gulf of Guinea Is., Haiti, Honduras, India, Jamaica, Leeward Is., Marianas, Marquesas, Mexico Southeast, New Caledonia, Nicaragua, Niue, Puerto Rico, Seychelles, Society Is., Tanzania, Tokelau-Manihiki, Tonga, Trinidad-Tobago, Venezuela, Venezuelan Antilles, Windward Is.
